llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must map React Native `AppState` transitions to `focusManager.setFocused(...)` by subscribing to `change` events via `addEventListener`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: AppState.addEventListener is used but calls refetch() directly instead of mapping to focusManager.setFocused(...). focusManager is never imported or referenced.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must map connectivity signals to `onlineManager.setOnline(...)` by subscribing to connectivity changes via `NetInfo.addEventListener` and using conservative online detection (`isConnected` + `isInternetReachable`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: NetInfo.addEventListener is used but calls refetch() directly instead of onlineManager.setOnline(...). onlineManager is never imported or referenced. Additionally, only isInternetReachable is checked; isConnected is not used in the conservative conjunction check.
evidence: const unsubscribe = NetInfo.addEventListener((state: NetInfoStateType) => { setIsOnline(state.isInternetReachable ?? false); if (state.isInternetReachable) { refetch() } })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use TanStack Query v5 object-form APIs for query hooks and client methods.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useQuery is called with object-form signature ({ queryKey, queryFn, staleTime, gcTime }). QueryClient is instantiated with object-form defaultOptions. No positional-argument (v4-style) APIs are used.
evidence: useQuery({ queryKey: ['todos', skip], queryFn: () => fetchTodos(3, skip), staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000 })
new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { refetchOnWindowFocus: false, retry: 1 } } })
